estimand: R_native checkpoint-by-field-by-carrier outcome, control, and delta matrix
replacement_rule: run_02 only after run_01 generation ineligibility before tomography
finality_rule: the first run entering tomography is final regardless of outcome
notes: native-to-task means the prescribed task without the proposed retention intervention
generation and probe prompts exclude hermeneutic and metacognitive scaffolding
all tomography requests are fresh and stateless
target and donor full prefixes are task-adherence upper bounds
wrong-trial latest uses the donor artifact from the same checkpoint
adjacent temporal cross-scoring is derived and issues no additional request
cells are correlated completeness checks, not independent replications
